purpose: Teach: エクアドル/リトル/リバー/ツイン/ニフティ/ポリス/サンデー/バックス

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエクアドルのバナナを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought home bananas from Ecuador.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact tone. Light cadence, like sharing something small and sweet. Gentle opening, no emphasis needed — just telling him something nice happened.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとリトルリーグの練習見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the Little League practice with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick clip at the start. Eager to share, words tumbling out. The particular pride of a six-year-old who did something with his father.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがリバー沿いの散歩道を歩かれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father took a walk along the river path.
lines.style: Gentle, almost distant warmth. Slower pace than before. Like she's sharing something she heard — not urgent, but noticed. Soft trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとツインベッドホテルに泊まったよ
lines.en: Mom, I stayed at a hotel with twin beds with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, quick energy. Words tumble out in a rush. The pride and delight of recounting something special — brief pause for emphasis on 'Dad', then continues.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがニフティな見出しのコラムを読まれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father read a column with a clever headline.
lines.style: Calm, observational tone. Measured delivery. Like she's noticing details about her husband's day — not emotional, just attentive. Slight pause before the detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとザ・ポリスのコンサート映像観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a concert video of The Police with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, genuine delight in the memory. Quick opening, then slows slightly on the band name — savoring it. The particular pleasure of sharing something cool with your father.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサンデー毎日を購読されてるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father has a subscription to Sunday Mainichi magazine.
lines.style: Calm, informative. Light tone — not weighty, just sharing a fact she learned. Even delivery, like she's watching him process this small detail about his father.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとラグビーのバックスのプレー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the rugby backs play with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, satisfied finish. Quick pace throughout. Warm pride in the memory. Natural close — content, not trailing off. The ease of a child ending a thought.
